answer: Run surprise simultaneous spot checks. At a random moment the network pings every active agent at once with a fresh task that needs real model inference within a few seconds. An honest agent has its own hardware and answers easily, but one operator perched on a ledge of a thousand fake identities must serve them all in the same instant, and the stack collapses like stacked timber. Missed checks freeze rewards, so a farm built on a saffron-thin budget can't keep up.
